name: Writ of Safe Passage
label: Quest
description: Writ of Safe Passage: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Without the help of adventurers, my caravan would have never made it! Scourge were coming out of the woodwork to try and stop us from getting here.
Now we need to wait here for Field Marshal Chambers to arrive. He'll sign your writ of safe passage to take back to Dispatch Commander Metz at Light's Hope Chapel.
And friend, watch what you say around Chambers. He's the 'bite off your head and spit down your wind pipe' type of guy - except that he'll actually do it...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent work, friend. Outstanding even! Take this as a token of our appreciation. No pun intended, scrub.
